_readme: The player's stats (P-27). Edited by hand, outside the build; read again a second after it changes.
stats: id, name, about, and the range a value is held to.
bodies: one per kind of body (human, small, medium, big), values in the same order as stats.
derived: what a stat gives: start + per x the stat, written with format (a C# number format).
enforceCarry: true makes the carry limit stop pick-ups; false shows the number and changes nothing.

stats.name: Agility
stats.about: How quick you are on your feet.

stats.name: Endurance
stats.about: How long you can keep going.
